source: Original portrait-style items modeling Schwartz's ten basic values (Schwartz, 1992; the portrait format follows the public description of the PVQ). No PVQ or ESS human-values items were used.

scale.prompt_suffix: How much like you is that person? Not like me at all, not like me, a little like me, somewhat like me, like me, or very much like me?

conformity.name: Conformity
conformity.gist: restraint of actions that would upset others or break norms

tradition.name: Tradition
tradition.gist: respect for customs and ideas one's culture provides

benevolence.name: Benevolence
benevolence.gist: the welfare of people one is close to

universalism.name: Universalism
universalism.gist: understanding and protection of all people and nature

scoring_notes: Raw value score = mean of its items on 1-6. MRAT = mean of all answered items. Centered (ipsatized) score = raw minus MRAT, so positive means 'more important than this person's average value'. Top-3 and bottom-3 are by centered score. Higher-order dimensions = mean of their values' centered scores; hedonism is placed with openness to change (its usual home in Schwartz's analyses) and the raw output lets the report move it to self-enhancement if wanted. Confidence = spread of the centered scores (standard deviation 0.8 = full) times coverage; a flat profile (everything 'like me') scores low confidence. See scoring.ts.

items.text: Someone who needs to come up with their own ideas and do things their own way.
Someone who loves surprises and is always looking for new things to do.
Someone who wants to enjoy life and have a good time. Pleasure matters a lot to them.
Someone who wants to show how capable they are and have people admire what they do.
Someone who wants to be wealthy, with expensive things and money to spare.
Someone who needs to live in safe surroundings and avoids anything that might put them at risk.
Someone who believes people should follow the rules even when no one is watching.
Someone who thinks it's important to be humble and modest, and not to draw attention to themselves.
Someone who goes out of their way to help the people close to them and look after their wellbeing.
Someone who thinks everyone in the world should be treated equally and have the same chances.
Someone who wants to decide for themselves what they do, and values being free and independent.
Someone who seeks out adventure and risk, and wants an exciting life.
Someone who looks for every chance to indulge and treat themselves.
Someone who wants to be very successful and get ahead.
Someone who wants to be in charge and have others do what they say.
Someone who thinks it's very important that the country is safe and the rules are enforced.
Someone who always behaves properly and avoids doing anything others would say is wrong.
Someone who keeps the customs their family or faith handed down to them.
Someone who is loyal to their friends and wants to devote themselves to the people they care about.
Someone who listens to people who are different from them and tries to understand them, even when they disagree.
Someone who cares deeply about nature and looking after the environment.
